name: state_at_end
title: Active SGR at the end of a string

origin.description: Active SGR at the end of a string.
origin.usage: state_at_end(x, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE))

arguments.name: normalize
arguments.text: Emit one SGR code per sequence.

arguments.name: carry
arguments.text: TRUE keeps the previous element's style.

origin.details: Reads SGR and OSC hyperlinks and returns the sequence still active at the end. carry=True continues that state into the next element.
origin.value: A character vector, or a data frame for unhandled_ctl.

translation.description: Active SGR at the end of a string.

arguments.name: normalize
arguments.text: Emit one SGR code per sequence.

arguments.name: carry
arguments.text: TRUE keeps the previous element's style.

translation.details: Reads SGR and OSC hyperlinks and returns the sequence still active at the end. carry=True continues that state into the next element. A string is one element. None is a missing string. term_cap is the R term.cap argument.
translation.value: A list of strings, or a dict of columns for unhandled_ctl.
